p: "We learned: 'And the judgment of His people Yisrael,
דְּבַר יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ' (מְלָכִים א ח, נט).
each day's matter on its day' (I Melachim 8:59).
'Day on its day' — what is it?
אֶלָּא הָנֵי תְּרֵי יוֹמִין דְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה.
Rather, these are the two days of Rosh Hashanah.
Because they are two courts of judgment
the upper judgment, which is harsh,
with the lower judgment, which is soft."
וְהַיְינוּ בְּחִינַת ה׳ עִלָּאָה וְה׳ תַּתָּאָה,
That is, the aspect of the upper Hei and the lower Hei,
and both of them dwell in the heart.
For the lower fear as well,
on the verse "when he has no heart" (Mishlei 17:16) —
but has no fear of Heaven.
And Binah, which is "Binah is the heart,"
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (בְּפֶתַח אֵלִיָּהוּ, הַקְדָּמַת תִּקּוּנֵי זֹהַר),
as written (in Pesach Eliyahu, Introduction to Tikkunei Zohar),
is when the fear has already entered
the inwardness of the point within the heart.
And these are the aspects of the Written Torah
עַל יוֹם ב׳ שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה
regarding the second day of Rosh Hashanah
in the verse "each day's matter on its day,"
which was said by Shlomo HaMelech, alav hashalom,
שֶׁהוּא הָיָה בְּחִינַת תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה,
who was the aspect of the Oral Torah —
the lower Wisdom, the wisdom of Shlomo.
And also the allusion in the Torah:
yet in truth, by Torah law there is no difference;
רַק לִרְמֹז עַל תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה מִדְּרַבָּנָן.
it is only to allude to the Oral Torah, rabbinic law.
has a great root in the Torah.
Therefore, even in the time of the Beis HaMikdash
for the reason that witnesses came
מִן הַמִּנְחָה וּלְמַעְלָה (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה ל, ב),
and they are like one long day.
For in truth the two aspects
as it says, "each day's matter on its day":
"'The word of Hashem' (Amos 8:12) — this is halachah";
'הָלוֹךְ וְדַבֵּר' (מְלָכִים ב ב, יא) בְּדִבְרֵי תוֹרָה.
"'Walking and talking' (II Melachim 2:11) — in words of Torah."
דְּיוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן הוּא נֶגֶד בְּחִינַת תּוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב,
The first day corresponds to the aspect of the Written Torah,
and then an illumination flows from Above
even into the inwardness of the point in the heart,
from the aspect of the Hidden World,
as stated (in the holy Zohar there)
the Fear of Yitzchak, the concealed judgment, etc.,
and both of them are as one."
And on the second day one comes,
עַל יְדֵי הִתְגַּלּוּת תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה,
through the revelation of the Oral Torah,
likewise to the aspect of the point in the heart,
"For with much wisdom comes much anger" —
שֶׁכְּדֵי לְהַכְנִיעַ הָרוֹב כַּעַס שֶׁל הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע,
meaning that to subdue the "much anger" of the yetzer hara,
it is done through the "much wisdom,"
which is the aspect of the Oral Torah.
the illumination of the inwardness of the point in the heart,
as stated (in the holy Zohar there)
"'Fortunate is the people who know the teruah;
Hashem, in the light of Your countenance they walk':
the secret of the teruah, as it says,
'You will smash them with an iron rod' (Tehillim 2:9);
and all those who know the secret of the teruah
will merit and draw near to walk
in the light of the countenance of the Holy One, blessed be He;
and this is the primordial light
that the Holy One, blessed be He, stored away for the righteous."
